system.description:
You draw a thrown weapon as part of the attack that throws it. Your thrown weapons' range and long range double, and after a fight you recover every thrown weapon that didn't break.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.
